name: Pro Opportunity Intake - End-to-End POC
description: Local-first teaching POC: intake, validation, normalization, duplicate check, structured AI mock, deterministic routing, human review, mock CRM, notification, and audit result.

parameters.formDescription: Tell us about your project and a Pro sales specialist will review it.

options.formSubmittedText: Thank you. Your opportunity has been received.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { first_name: 'Sarah', last_name: 'Kim', email: 'sarah@atlasrenovations.com', company: 'Atlas Renovations', phone: '(512) 555-0199', estimated_budget: 180000, desired_timeline: 'This fall', products_services: 'cabinets, countertops, delivery, installation', project_description: "We're remodeling twelve kitchens this fall. We'll probably need cabinets, countertops, delivery, and possibly installation. Please have someone contact us next week." } }];

const raw = $json; const errors = []; const email = String(raw.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(); const budget = Number(raw.estimated_budget); if (!String(raw.first_name ?? '').trim()) errors.push('first_name is required'); if (!String(raw.last_name ?? '').trim()) errors.push('last_name is required'); if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) errors.push('email is invalid'); if (!Number.isFinite(budget) || budget < 0) errors.push('estimated_budget must be a positive number'); if (!String(raw.project_description ?? '').trim()) errors.push('project_description is required'); const normalized = { first_name: String(raw.first_name ?? '').trim(), last_name: String(raw.last_name ?? '').trim(), email, company: String(raw.company ?? '').trim(), phone: String(raw.phone ?? '').replace(/\D/g, ''), estimated_budget: Number.isFinite(budget) ? budget : null, desired_timeline: String(raw.desired_timeline ?? '').trim(), products_services: Array.isArray(raw.products_services) ? raw.products_services : String(raw.products_services ?? '').split(',').map(v => v.trim()).filter(Boolean), project_description: String(raw.project_description ?? '').trim() }; const key = `${email}|${normalized.company.toLowerCase()}|${normalized.project_description.toLowerCase().slice(0,80)}`; return [{ json: { submission_id: `sub-${Date.now()}`, received_at: new Date().toISOString(), source: 'pro_intake_form', validation_status: errors.length ? 'invalid' : 'valid', validation_errors: errors, idempotency_key: key, normalized } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, workflow_status: 'rejected_validation', customer_message: 'Please correct the highlighted fields.', audit: { current_step: 'validation', errors: $json.validation_errors, retry_count: 0, human_review_required: false } } }];

const existing = $json.normalized.email.startsWith('existing@'); return [{ json: { ...$json, duplicate: existing, existing_crm_record_id: existing ? 'CRM-EXISTING-1001' : null, duplicate_check: 'mock_by_email' } }];

const d = $json.normalized.project_description.toLowerCase(); const products = ['cabinets','countertops','delivery','installation'].filter(p => d.includes(p)); const quantityMatch = d.match(/\b(\d+)\b/); const quantity = quantityMatch ? Number(quantityMatch[1]) : (d.includes('twelve') ? 12 : null); const confidence = d.length >= 40 && products.length >= 2 ? 0.92 : 0.55; const ai = { project_type: d.includes('kitchen') ? 'multi-unit kitchen remodel' : 'general project', quantity, products: products.filter(p => p !== 'installation'), possible_services: products.includes('installation') ? ['installation'] : [], timeline: d.includes('fall') ? 'fall' : $json.normalized.desired_timeline || 'unknown', intent: 'sales inquiry', summary: `${$json.normalized.company || 'Customer'} requests help with ${products.join(', ') || 'an unspecified project'}.`, confidence }; return [{ json: { ...$json, ai, ai_schema_valid: Array.isArray(ai.products) && typeof ai.confidence === 'number' } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, workflow_status: 'human_review', human_review_reason: 'AI output was missing, invalid, or below the 0.75 confidence threshold.', audit: { current_step: 'ai_validation', ai_confidence: $json.ai?.confidence ?? null, retry_count: 0, human_review_required: true } } }];

const b = $json.normalized.estimated_budget; const rules = { qualified: b >= 10000, high_value: b >= 150000, priority: b >= 150000 ? 'high' : b >= 50000 ? 'medium' : 'standard', sales_queue: b >= 150000 ? 'enterprise_pro_review' : b >= 50000 ? 'pro_sales' : 'standard_sales' }; return [{ json: { ...$json, rules } }];

return [{ json: { ...$json, workflow_status: 'human_review', human_review_reason: 'Opportunity is at or above the $150,000 approval threshold.', proposed_queue: $json.rules.sales_queue, audit: { current_step: 'high_value_review', decision: 'awaiting_human_approval', ai_confidence: $json.ai.confidence, retry_count: 0, human_review_required: true } } }];

const crmId = $json.crm_record_id || `CRM-${$json.submission_id}`; const crm_payload = { operation: $json.crm_operation, record_id: crmId, contact: $json.normalized, opportunity: { summary: $json.ai.summary, products: $json.ai.products, services: $json.ai.possible_services, budget: $json.normalized.estimated_budget, priority: $json.rules.priority, queue: $json.rules.sales_queue } }; return [{ json: { ...$json, crm_record_id: crmId, crm_payload, crm_status: 'mock_success' } }];
const rep = $json.rules.sales_queue === 'pro_sales' ? 'Pro Sales Queue' : 'Standard Sales Queue'; return [{ json: { ...$json, assigned_rep: rep, assignment_status: 'assigned' } }];

const notification = { channel: 'mock_email_or_slack', recipient: $json.assigned_rep, subject: `New ${$json.rules.priority} priority opportunity`, message: `${$json.normalized.first_name} ${$json.normalized.last_name} from ${$json.normalized.company}: ${$json.ai.summary}`, crm_record_id: $json.crm_record_id }; return [{ json: { ...$json, notification, notification_status: 'mock_sent' } }];

return [{ json: { submission_id: $json.submission_id, workflow_status: 'completed', decision: 'routed_to_sales', assigned_rep: $json.assigned_rep, crm_record_id: $json.crm_record_id, ai_confidence: $json.ai.confidence, retry_count: 0, human_review_required: false, notification_status: $json.notification_status, completed_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
